name: com.dankmachine/dank-meme-sounds
title: DankMachine meme sounds
description: Meme soundboard for AI agents: 38k meme sounds. Find reaction sounds, search, trending, play.

tools.name: browse_sounds
tools.description: Get up to 50 candidate sounds with everything known about each one: about, origin (where the meme comes from, only when known), how_used (how people use it), variations, moods, use_cases, good_for platforms, tags and popularity. Filter by mood, use_case, category or platform (see list_filters), optionally narrow with a query, then choose the best sound yourself.

platform.description: tiktok, youtube, instagram-reels, capcut, discord, twitch, obs, zoom, video-editing, group-chats

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Every filter value browse_sounds accepts, with how many sounds have it.

tools.name: search_sounds
tools.description: Search DankMachine meme sound buttons by name, alias, tag, mood or use case. Returns playable MP3 URLs, pixel-art images and pages.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "vine boom", "dramatic bass", "minecraft"

mood.description: Optional mood, e.g. funny, dramatic, awkward, victory, fail, surprise, scary, hype

tools.name: find_reaction_sound
tools.description: Describe a moment ("my code finally compiled", "awkward silence", "plot twist") and get candidate meme sounds with their full culture (origin, how_used, moods, use_cases, good_for platforms). Read them and pick the one that fits best yourself.

tools.name: get_sound
tools.description: Full metadata for one sound by slug (or the best match for a query).

sound.description: Slug like "vine-boom-sound-70972" or a search query

tools.name: get_trending_sounds
tools.description: What people are actually pressing on DankMachine right now.

tools.name: get_random_sound
tools.description: A random sound, optionally from one category or with one mood.
